title: Grilled Dutch Beef Skewers
description: A flavorful and nutritious recipe featuring tender Dutch beef, marinated in a mix of dark and nourishing ingredients, grilled to perfection.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, garlic, salt, and pepper.
3. Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix well.
4. Thread the marinated beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill grates with oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
7. Transfer the skewers to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
8. Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately.
